THE VERY REAL ORIGIN STORY

It started with
a sunburn.
And another
dead-end swipe.

THE GROUP CHAT

we should actually go out

okay. who’s in? ↗

more of this, please.

Spring break. A table full of friends.
One buddy’s Tinder. Zero plans.

We were sunburnt, drained, and doing what bored friends do: trying to find our buddy a match. Five minutes in, it was the same thing. Paywalls. Dead-end swipes. Conversations that went nowhere.

“The problem wasn’t matches.
It was that nothing ever
escaped the screen.”

So we started Hangs. For the concert you don’t want to go to alone. For the friend who needs a nudge. For the kind of connection that happens when you actually show up.

Built to get you out there.
See you on the other side of the screen.

FAIR QUESTIONS

A few things
before we hang.

Is it free?+

Yes. Always free. Meeting your people shouldn’t come with a price tag.

When does it launch?+

Hangs is launching at the University of Minnesota first. We’re launching in 2026; the exact date is still to come. Check back here for the launch update.

Is this a dating app or a friends app?+

Hangs is a dating app built around hanging out. Shared interests come first, and double dates let you bring a friend along. Less pressure, more ways to see if there’s a connection.

What about safety?+

For any first hang, meet in public, let a friend know your plan, and move at your own pace. Bringing a wingman can help you feel more comfortable. Hangs does not verify identities at launch.
